description: Retrieves a Sentry project's current data filtering settings, used to ignore events from sources like localhost, web crawlers, or legacy browsers.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for retrieving data filters for a Sentry project.

organization_id_or_slug.description: Unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

project_id_or_slug.description: Unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry project.
project_id_or_slug.title: Project Id Or Slug

inputSchema.title: RetrieveProjectFilterDataRequest

name: retrieve_project_filter_data

FilterObject.description: Schema for an individual filter object.

active.description: Filter activation status. Boolean for most filters (true=enabled, false=disabled). For 'legacy-browsers' filter, this is an array of browser names to filter (e.g., ['ie', 'chrome', 'safari']).
active.title: Active

FilterObject.title: FilterObject

RetrieveProjectFilterDataResponse.description: Response schema containing the data filters for the specified project.

data.description: List of project data filters. Each filter has an 'id' (identifier) and 'active' status (boolean or array of browser names for legacy-browsers filter).
data.title: Data
